6.description: [Onyxias Lair] Pending Restart: Increased the respawn time of Onyxian Warders to 7 days up from 2 hours.
[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] Finkle Einhorn can now be found in Onyxias Lair.
[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] Added a Heroic Version of Onyxias Head.

[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] Onyxia no longer drops Tier 2 head pieces directly. She now drops Tier 2 Head Token that can be exchanged for their represented Head Pieces at Major Mattingly in Stormwind and Overlord Runthak in Orgrimmar.
[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] Added a visual to the target of Fireball displaying the area of impact.
[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] Onyxia no longer pauses between Fireball casts during Phase 2.
[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] Optimized the transition into Phase 2. Onyxia will now start here Phase 2 routines faster.
[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] Onyxia no longer casts Wing Buffet.
[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] Greatly reduced the frequency of Cleave.

[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] Corrected an issue where Onyxias Flame Breath would select the targets it hit on cast rather then cast finish. Player that are in front of Onyxia when the cast begins will no longer get hit if they have moved out of it by the end of the cast.
[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] All creatures inside Onyxias Lair use new updated abilities. Player require the latest patches to experience the raid properly.
[Onyxias Lair][Onyxia] Updated Onyxia to latest standards - Ignoring Invisibility and Feign Death, despawn on evade, extra boss frame, removal of parry hasten rules, no combat reposition.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Area52] Fixed an issue where Survival Tactics wasn't reducing the cooldown of Silencing Shot.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Champion of Justice now requires you to effectively heal an ally but no longer has a health threshold. The Adorned and Champion of Justice buffs have had their durations increased from 10 to 15 seconds. (Tooltips will be adjusted to match this update shortly.)
[Pending Restart] Carnage Incarnate now only requires 12 stacks in order to trigger, down from 20. (Tooltips will be adjusted to match this update shortly.)

1.description: Fixed a bug allowing the 15% damage buffs from The Beast Within and Arcane Power to stack. As intended, none of the 15% damage buffs (including also Death Wish and Avenging Wrath) should now be able to stack with each other.
Fixed an issue where Sanctity of Battle wouldnt increase the damage of Hammer of Wrath. [Pending Restart]
Fixed a bug where Shield Bash could knockdown the target. [Requires Launcher update]
Dark Pact will now drain the correct amount of mana (was reduced by resilience before).

0.description: Sealed Cards and Golden Sealed Cards can no longer be deleted.
Optimized Hero Architect search to not include archived builds by default unless you are searching in that category.
The Hero Architect now requires players to pick an icon before submitting a build.
Released Hero Architect 2.0 on Area 52.
Warlock Pets will now persist through logouts. You will no longer need to resummon your demon when logging into the game.
Fixed an exploit allowing you to disconnect yourself when logging into your account from a different client.
Increased the chance to drop Jungle Remedy.

5.description: Linken's Boomerang is no longer usable in Arena.
Fixed a bug causing high AP multiplier values for custom artificial transmog weapons.

4.description: Personal Bank: You can no longer store class enchanted items (Rockbiter, Windfury, ...)
Prestige: Resetting your character will now also reset your instance and raid difficulty back to normal.
Transmog: Artificial items such as Skinning Knife and Pickaxe will no longer get automatically transmogrified when using them at Level 1.
Transmog: You can now transmogrify soulbound tradeable items. (Will cause these items to get bound.)

6.description: Fixed a bug causing Open World Bosses to have an additional +3 levels (??). They will now have the correct level for 63/73 (??).

Living Root of the Wildheart [Ascended] will now have a 35 second ICD.

Dreadmist Regailia - A primarily based intellect caster set will now appear in the intellect category in the mythic+ loot box and intellect has been matched to its spirit. 

This means that those items who had greater spirit, now have equal (or greater) intellect than spirit and said items with equal spirit and intellect can appear in both the Spirit and Intellect category of the mythic+ lootbox.

Weapons with previously only spell power, hit, crit or haste or combination of these 4 stats without any main stat (Agility, Stamina, Intellect, Spirit) will now ALSO appear in the Intellect category of the mythic+ lootbox.

Arena Frenzy now begins at 12 server time instead of 18. It now lasts for 24h on Area 52 as well.

[Mythic]+ Verek's Leash Previously an item in both the agility & intellect category made up of equal stats of both agility & intellect will no longer appear in the intellect category of the Mythic+ lootbox.

[Mythic]+ Coif of Elements Previously an item in both the agility & intellect category made up of equal stats of both agility & intellect will no longer appear in the intellect category of the Mythic+ lootbox.

Fixed an issue where some of the Tier 1 & Tier 2 sets had no set bonuses for the heroic verson of the gear. Requires cache clear & server restart.
Fixed an issue where disenchanting certain bloodforge items would not have a chance to yield HR materials.

PvP Cap will receive some changes:
- each week the cap will increase by 1500 points.
- the cap will no longer "reset" each week, rather it will just increase.
- (1 week: 1500, 2nd: 3000, 3rd: 4500, ...)
- no more difference between rated and normal cap
- cap will no longer increase with rating (flat 1500 cap for everyone)
---------------------------------------------
These changes will come to Al'ar with the next PvP Season

7.description:
[Pending Restart] Tweaks to Carnage Incarnate. The periodic damage of the Rend attack from Carnage Incarnate now has an attack power coefficient of 8% and generates more threat. It also has a chance to give a stack of Consume Blood when dealing damage to monsters.

The duration of Consume Blood now lasts 30 seconds, from 15.

The heal effect has been changed into a periodic effect that heals you every second for 3 seconds. It now has a 10 second internal cooldown and still only removes one stack of Consume Blood, making it consume fewer stacks overall.
